005package org.wpilib.simulation;
006
007import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Pose2d;
008import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
009import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Matrix;
010import org.wpilib.math.linalg.VecBuilder;
011import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N1;
012import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N2;
013import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N7;
014import org.wpilib.math.random.Normal;
015import org.wpilib.math.system.DCMotor;
016import org.wpilib.math.system.LinearSystem;
017import org.wpilib.math.system.Models;
018import org.wpilib.math.system.NumericalIntegration;
019import org.wpilib.math.util.Nat;
020import org.wpilib.math.util.StateSpaceUtil;
021import org.wpilib.math.util.Units;

024/**
025 * This class simulates the state of the drivetrain. In simulationPeriodic, users should first set
026 * inputs from motors with {@link #setInputs(double, double)}, call {@link #update(double)} to
027 * update the simulation, and set estimated encoder and gyro positions, as well as estimated
028 * odometry pose. Teams can use {@link org.wpilib.smartdashboard.Field2d} to visualize their robot
029 * on the Sim GUI's field.
030 *
031 * <p>Our state-space system is:
032 *
033 * <p>x = [[x, y, theta, vel_l, vel_r, dist_l, dist_r]]ᵀ in the field coordinate system (dist_* are
034 * wheel distances.)
035 *
036 * <p>u = [[voltage_l, voltage_r]]ᵀ This is typically the control input of the last timestep from a
037 * LTVDiffDriveController.
038 *
039 * <p>y = x
040 */
041public class DifferentialDrivetrainSim {
042  private final DCMotor m_motor;
043  private final double m_originalGearing;
044  private final Matrix<N7, N1> m_measurementStdDevs;
045  private double m_currentGearing;
046  private final double m_wheelRadius;
047
048  private Matrix<N2, N1> m_u;
049  private Matrix<N7, N1> m_x;
050  private Matrix<N7, N1> m_y;
051
052  private final double m_rb;
053  private final LinearSystem<N2, N2, N2> m_plant;
054
055  /**
056   * Creates a simulated differential drivetrain.
057   *
058   * @param driveMotor A {@link DCMotor} representing the left side of the drivetrain.
059   * @param gearing The gearing ratio between motor and wheel, as output over input. This must be
060   *     the same ratio as the ratio used to identify or create the drivetrainPlant.
061   * @param j The moment of inertia of the drivetrain about its center in kg-m².
062   * @param mass The mass of the drivebase in kg.
063   * @param wheelRadius The radius of the wheels on the drivetrain in meters.
064   * @param trackwidth The robot's trackwidth, or distance between left and right wheels, in meters.
065   * @param measurementStdDevs Standard deviations for measurements, in the form [x, y, heading,
066   *     left velocity, right velocity, left distance, right distance]ᵀ. Can be null if no noise is
067   *     desired. Gyro standard deviations of 0.0001 radians, velocity standard deviations of 0.05
068   *     m/s, and position measurement standard deviations of 0.005 meters are a reasonable starting
069   *     point.
070   */
071  public DifferentialDrivetrainSim(
072      DCMotor driveMotor,
073      double gearing,
074      double j,
075      double mass,
076      double wheelRadius,
077      double trackwidth,
078      Matrix<N7, N1> measurementStdDevs) {
079    this(
080        Models.differentialDriveFromPhysicalConstants(
081            driveMotor, mass, wheelRadius, trackwidth / 2.0, j, gearing),
082        driveMotor,
083        gearing,
084        trackwidth,
085        wheelRadius,
086        measurementStdDevs);
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Creates a simulated differential drivetrain.
091   *
092   * @param plant The {@link LinearSystem} representing the robot's drivetrain. This system can be
093   *     created with {@link
094   *     org.wpilib.math.system.Models#differentialDriveFromPhysicalConstants(DCMotor, double,
095   *     double, double, double, double)} or {@link
096   *     org.wpilib.math.system.Models#differentialDriveFromSysId(double, double, double, double)}.
097   * @param driveMotor A {@link DCMotor} representing the drivetrain.
098   * @param gearing The gearingRatio ratio of the robot, as output over input. This must be the same
099   *     ratio as the ratio used to identify or create the drivetrainPlant.
100   * @param trackwidth The distance between the two sides of the drivetrain in meters. Can be found
101   *     with SysId.
102   * @param wheelRadius The radius of the wheels on the drivetrain, in meters.
103   * @param measurementStdDevs Standard deviations for measurements, in the form [x, y, heading,
104   *     left velocity, right velocity, left distance, right distance]ᵀ. Can be null if no noise is
105   *     desired. Gyro standard deviations of 0.0001 radians, velocity standard deviations of 0.05
106   *     m/s, and position measurement standard deviations of 0.005 meters are a reasonable starting
107   *     point.
108   */
109  public DifferentialDrivetrainSim(
110      LinearSystem<N2, N2, N2> plant,
111      DCMotor driveMotor,
112      double gearing,
113      double trackwidth,
114      double wheelRadius,
115      Matrix<N7, N1> measurementStdDevs) {
116    this.m_plant = plant;
117    this.m_rb = trackwidth / 2.0;
118    this.m_motor = driveMotor;
119    this.m_originalGearing = gearing;
120    this.m_measurementStdDevs = measurementStdDevs;
121    m_wheelRadius = wheelRadius;
122    m_currentGearing = m_originalGearing;
123
124    m_x = new Matrix<>(Nat.N7(), Nat.N1());
125    m_u = VecBuilder.fill(0, 0);
126    m_y = new Matrix<>(Nat.N7(), Nat.N1());
127  }
128
129  /**
130   * Sets the applied voltage to the drivetrain. Note that positive voltage must make that side of
131   * the drivetrain travel forward (+X).
132   *
133   * @param leftVoltageVolts The left voltage.
134   * @param rightVoltageVolts The right voltage.
135   */
136  public void setInputs(double leftVoltageVolts, double rightVoltageVolts) {
137    m_u = clampInput(VecBuilder.fill(leftVoltageVolts, rightVoltageVolts));
138  }
139
140  /**
141   * Update the drivetrain states with the current time difference.
142   *
143   * @param dt the time difference in seconds
144   */
145  public void update(double dt) {
146    m_x = NumericalIntegration.rkdp(this::getDynamics, m_x, m_u, dt);
147    m_y = m_x;
148    if (m_measurementStdDevs != null) {
149      m_y = m_y.plus(Normal.normal(m_measurementStdDevs));
150    }
151  }
152
153  /**
154   * Returns the full simulated state of the drivetrain. Note that this will not include noise!
155   *
156   * @return The simulated state
157   */
158  public Matrix<N7, N1> getState() {
159    return m_x;
160  }
161
162  /**
163   * Get one of the drivetrain states. Note that this will not include noise!
164   *
165   * @param state the state to get
166   * @return the state
167   */
168  public double getState(State state) {
169    return m_x.get(state.value, 0);
170  }
171
172  private double getOutput(State output) {
173    return m_y.get(output.value, 0);
174  }
175
176  /**
177   * Returns the direction the robot is pointing.
178   *
179   * <p>Note that this angle is counterclockwise-positive, while most gyros are clockwise positive.
180   *
181   * @return The direction the robot is pointing.
182   */
183  public Rotation2d getHeading() {
184    return new Rotation2d(getOutput(State.HEADING));
185  }
186
187  /**
188   * Returns the current pose.
189   *
190   * @return The current pose.
191   */
192  public Pose2d getPose() {
193    return new Pose2d(getOutput(State.X), getOutput(State.Y), getHeading());
194  }
195
196  /**
197   * Get the right encoder position.
198   *
199   * @return The encoder position in meters.
200   */
201  public double getRightPosition() {
202    return getOutput(State.RIGHT_POSITION);
203  }
204
205  /**
206   * Get the right encoder velocity.
207   *
208   * @return The encoder velocity in meters per second.
209   */
210  public double getRightVelocity() {
211    return getOutput(State.RIGHT_VELOCITY);
212  }
213
214  /**
215   * Get the left encoder position.
216   *
217   * @return The encoder position in meters.
218   */
219  public double getLeftPosition() {
220    return getOutput(State.LEFT_POSITION);
221  }
222
223  /**
224   * Get the left encoder velocity.
225   *
226   * @return The encoder velocity in meters per second.
227   */
228  public double getLeftVelocity() {
229    return getOutput(State.LEFT_VELOCITY);
230  }
231
232  /**
233   * Get the current draw of the left side of the drivetrain.
234   *
235   * @return the drivetrain's left side current draw, in amps
236   */
237  public double getLeftCurrentDraw() {
238    return m_motor.getCurrent(
239            getState(State.LEFT_VELOCITY) * m_currentGearing / m_wheelRadius, m_u.get(0, 0))
240        * Math.signum(m_u.get(0, 0));
241  }
242
243  /**
244   * Get the current draw of the right side of the drivetrain.
245   *
246   * @return the drivetrain's right side current draw, in amps
247   */
248  public double getRightCurrentDraw() {
249    return m_motor.getCurrent(
250            getState(State.RIGHT_VELOCITY) * m_currentGearing / m_wheelRadius, m_u.get(1, 0))
251        * Math.signum(m_u.get(1, 0));
252  }
253
254  /**
255   * Get the current draw of the drivetrain.
256   *
257   * @return the current draw, in amps
258   */
259  public double getCurrentDraw() {
260    return getLeftCurrentDraw() + getRightCurrentDraw();
261  }
262
263  /**
264   * Get the drivetrain gearing.
265   *
266   * @return the gearing ration
267   */
268  public double getCurrentGearing() {
269    return m_currentGearing;
270  }
271
272  /**
273   * Sets the gearing reduction on the drivetrain. This is commonly used for shifting drivetrains.
274   *
275   * @param newGearRatio The new gear ratio, as output over input.
276   */
277  public void setCurrentGearing(double newGearRatio) {
278    this.m_currentGearing = newGearRatio;
279  }
280
281  /**
282   * Sets the system state.
283   *
284   * @param state The state.
285   */
286  public void setState(Matrix<N7, N1> state) {
287    m_x = state;
288  }
289
290  /**
291   * Sets the system pose.
292   *
293   * @param pose The pose.
294   */
295  public void setPose(Pose2d pose) {
296    m_x.set(State.X.value, 0, pose.getX());
297    m_x.set(State.Y.value, 0, pose.getY());
298    m_x.set(State.HEADING.value, 0, pose.getRotation().getRadians());
299    m_x.set(State.LEFT_POSITION.value, 0, 0);
300    m_x.set(State.RIGHT_POSITION.value, 0, 0);
301  }
302
303  /**
304   * The differential drive dynamics function.
305   *
306   * @param x The state.
307   * @param u The input.
308   * @return The state derivative with respect to time.
309   */
310  protected Matrix<N7, N1> getDynamics(Matrix<N7, N1> x, Matrix<N2, N1> u) {
311    // Because G can be factored out of B, we can divide by the old ratio and multiply
312    // by the new ratio to get a new drivetrain model.
313    var B = new Matrix<>(Nat.N4(), Nat.N2());
314    B.assignBlock(0, 0, m_plant.getB().times(this.m_currentGearing / this.m_originalGearing));
315
316    // Because G² can be factored out of A, we can divide by the old ratio squared and multiply
317    // by the new ratio squared to get a new drivetrain model.
318    var A = new Matrix<>(Nat.N4(), Nat.N4());
319    A.assignBlock(
320        0,
321        0,
322        m_plant
323            .getA()
324            .times(
325                (this.m_currentGearing * this.m_currentGearing)
326                    / (this.m_originalGearing * this.m_originalGearing)));
327
328    A.assignBlock(2, 0, Matrix.eye(Nat.N2()));
329
330    var v = (x.get(State.LEFT_VELOCITY.value, 0) + x.get(State.RIGHT_VELOCITY.value, 0)) / 2.0;
331
332    var xdot = new Matrix<>(Nat.N7(), Nat.N1());
333    xdot.set(0, 0, v * Math.cos(x.get(State.HEADING.value, 0)));
334    xdot.set(1, 0, v * Math.sin(x.get(State.HEADING.value, 0)));
335    xdot.set(
336        2,
337        0,
338        (x.get(State.RIGHT_VELOCITY.value, 0) - x.get(State.LEFT_VELOCITY.value, 0))
339            / (2.0 * m_rb));
340    xdot.assignBlock(3, 0, A.times(x.block(Nat.N4(), Nat.N1(), 3, 0)).plus(B.times(u)));
341
342    return xdot;
343  }
344
345  /**
346   * Clamp the input vector such that no element exceeds the battery voltage. If any does, the
347   * relative magnitudes of the input will be maintained.
348   *
349   * @param u The input vector.
350   * @return The normalized input.
351   */
352  protected Matrix<N2, N1> clampInput(Matrix<N2, N1> u) {
353    return StateSpaceUtil.desaturateInputVector(u, RobotController.getBatteryVoltage());
354  }
355
356  /** Represents the different states of the drivetrain. */
357  public enum State {
358    /** The X position state. */
359    X(0),
360    /** The Y position state. */
361    Y(1),
362    /** The heading state. */
363    HEADING(2),
364    /** The left-side velocity state. */
365    LEFT_VELOCITY(3),
366    /** The right-side velocity state. */
367    RIGHT_VELOCITY(4),
368    /** The left-side position state. */
369    LEFT_POSITION(5),
370    /** The right-side position state. */
371    RIGHT_POSITION(6);
372
373    /** The row in the state vector the state corresponds to. */
374    public final int value;
375
376    State(int i) {
377      this.value = i;
378    }
379  }
380
381  /**
382   * Represents a gearing option of the Toughbox mini. 12.75:1 -- 14:50 and 14:50 10.71:1 -- 14:50
383   * and 16:48 8.45:1 -- 14:50 and 19:45 7.31:1 -- 14:50 and 21:43 5.95:1 -- 14:50 and 24:40
384   */
385  public enum KitbotGearing {
386    /** Gear ratio of 12.75:1. */
387    RATIO_12P75(12.75),
388    /** Gear ratio of 10.71:1. */
389    RATIO_10P71(10.71),
390    /** Gear ratio of 8.45:1. */
391    RATIO_8P45(8.45),
392    /** Gear ratio of 7.31:1. */
393    RATIO_7P31(7.31),
394    /** Gear ratio of 5.95:1. */
395    RATIO_5P95(5.95);
396
397    /** KitbotGearing value. */
398    public final double value;
399
400    KitbotGearing(double i) {
401      this.value = i;
402    }
403  }
404
405  /** Represents common motor layouts of the kit drivetrain. */
406  public enum KitbotMotor {
407    /** One CIM motor per drive side. */
408    SINGLE_CIM_PER_SIDE(DCMotor.getCIM(1)),
409    /** Two CIM motors per drive side. */
410    DUAL_CIM_PER_SIDE(DCMotor.getCIM(2)),
411    /** One Mini CIM motor per drive side. */
412    SINGLE_MINI_CIM_PER_SIDE(DCMotor.getMiniCIM(1)),
413    /** Two Mini CIM motors per drive side. */
414    DUAL_MINI_CIM_PER_SIDE(DCMotor.getMiniCIM(2)),
415    /** One Falcon 500 motor per drive side. */
416    SINGLE_FALCON_500_PER_SIDE(DCMotor.getFalcon500(1)),
417    /** Two Falcon 500 motors per drive side. */
418    DUAL_FALCON_500_PER_SIDE(DCMotor.getFalcon500(2)),
419    /** One NEO motor per drive side. */
420    SINGLE_NEO_PER_SIDE(DCMotor.getNEO(1)),
421    /** Two NEO motors per drive side. */
422    DUAL_NEO_PER_SIDE(DCMotor.getNEO(2));
423
424    /** KitbotMotor value. */
425    public final DCMotor value;
426
427    KitbotMotor(DCMotor i) {
428      this.value = i;
429    }
430  }
431
432  /** Represents common wheel sizes of the kit drivetrain. */
433  public enum KitbotWheelSize {
434    /** Six inch diameter wheels. */
435    SIX_INCH(Units.inchesToMeters(6)),
436    /** Eight inch diameter wheels. */
437    EIGHT_INCH(Units.inchesToMeters(8)),
438    /** Ten inch diameter wheels. */
439    TEN_INCH(Units.inchesToMeters(10));
440
441    /** KitbotWheelSize value. */
442    public final double value;
443
444    KitbotWheelSize(double i) {
445      this.value = i;
446    }
447  }

449  /**
450   * Create a sim for the standard FRC kitbot.
451   *
452   * @param motor The motors installed in the bot.
453   * @param gearing The gearing reduction used.
454   * @param wheelSize The wheel size.
455   * @param measurementStdDevs Standard deviations for measurements, in the form [x, y, heading,
456   *     left velocity, right velocity, left distance, right distance]ᵀ. Can be null if no noise is
457   *     desired. Gyro standard deviations of 0.0001 radians, velocity standard deviations of 0.05
458   *     m/s, and position measurement standard deviations of 0.005 meters are a reasonable starting
459   *     point.
460   * @return A sim for the standard FRC kitbot.
461   */
462  public static DifferentialDrivetrainSim createKitbotSim(
463      KitbotMotor motor,
464      KitbotGearing gearing,
465      KitbotWheelSize wheelSize,
466      Matrix<N7, N1> measurementStdDevs) {
467    // MOI estimation -- note that I = mr² for point masses
468    var batteryMoi = 12.5 / 2.2 * Math.pow(Units.inchesToMeters(10), 2);
469    var gearboxMoi =
470        (2.8 /* CIM motor */ * 2 / 2.2 + 2.0 /* Toughbox Mini- ish */)
471            * Math.pow(Units.inchesToMeters(26.0 / 2.0), 2);
472
473    return createKitbotSim(motor, gearing, wheelSize, batteryMoi + gearboxMoi, measurementStdDevs);
474  }
475
476  /**
477   * Create a sim for the standard FRC kitbot.
478   *
479   * @param motor The motors installed in the bot.
480   * @param gearing The gearing reduction used.
481   * @param wheelSize The wheel size.
482   * @param j The moment of inertia of the drivebase in kg-m². This can be calculated using SysId.
483   * @param measurementStdDevs Standard deviations for measurements, in the form [x, y, heading,
484   *     left velocity, right velocity, left distance, right distance]ᵀ. Can be null if no noise is
485   *     desired. Gyro standard deviations of 0.0001 radians, velocity standard deviations of 0.05
486   *     m/s, and position measurement standard deviations of 0.005 meters are a reasonable starting
487   *     point.
488   * @return A sim for the standard FRC kitbot.
489   */
490  public static DifferentialDrivetrainSim createKitbotSim(
491      KitbotMotor motor,
492      KitbotGearing gearing,
493      KitbotWheelSize wheelSize,
494      double j,
495      Matrix<N7, N1> measurementStdDevs) {
496    return new DifferentialDrivetrainSim(
497        motor.value,
498        gearing.value,
499        j,
500        Units.lbsToKilograms(60),
501        wheelSize.value / 2.0,
502        Units.inchesToMeters(26),
503        measurementStdDevs);
504  }
505}
